skills.name: Power Strike
skills.description: Unleashes a powerful strike dealing 200% weapon damage.

skills.name: Thrust
skills.description: A fast, high-accuracy piercing thrust dealing 150% weapon damage with an increased hit chance.

skills.name: Riposte
skills.description: A guaranteed counter-strike usable only immediately after evading or parrying an attack, dealing 180% weapon damage.

skills.name: Fleche
skills.description: A running lunge dash-strike that instantly closes distance to a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 160% weapon damage on arrival.

skills.name: Blade Dance
skills.description: The duelist's capstone: delivers 4 rapid strikes against the target dealing a total of 320% weapon damage.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.description: Quickly tends to wounds, restoring 20 HP to a damaged ally or self.

skills.name: Smite
skills.description: A single-target offensive holy strike, dealing 180% damage to an enemy from up to 5 tiles away.

skills.name: Cleanse
skills.description: Purifies a targeted ally or self, removing all active harmful status effects (Bleed, Burn, Shock, etc.).

skills.name: Guardian's Ward
skills.description: Places a protective ward on an ally or self, absorbing up to 35 incoming damage for 8s.

skills.name: Holy Nova
skills.description: Combat Medic capstone: unleashes an explosion of holy energy in a 4-tile radius that simultaneously damages enemies for 200% damage and heals allies for 30 HP.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: Short-range shield strike dealing 120% weapon damage and stunning the target for 2s.

skills.name: Guard Up
skills.description: Braces defense for 5s, mitigating 50% of all incoming damage.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Unleashes a commanding shout, forcing all nearby enemies within 5 tiles to target this character for 6s.

skills.name: Retaliate
skills.description: Prepares a retaliatory stance; the next incoming attack taken triggers a guaranteed free counterattack.

skills.name: Unbreakable
skills.description: Hardens will and armor to become completely impervious to all damage for 4s.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.description: A devastating overhead strike dealing 180% weapon damage and stunning the target for 2s.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Restoration Mage baseline: channels restorative magic to instantly heal an ally or self for 35 HP.

skills.name: Regenerate
skills.description: Applies a heal-over-time effect to an ally or self, restoring 6 HP every second for 8s (48 HP total).

skills.name: Barrier
skills.description: Envelops an ally or self in a resilient magical barrier, absorbing up to 50 incoming damage for 10s.

skills.name: Blessed Weapons
skills.description: Enchants all living party members' weapons with holy power for 60s, granting +5 Holy bonus damage on each attack.

skills.name: Mass Revive
skills.description: Restoration Mage capstone: calls upon divine grace to resurrect all downed allies within a 6-tile radius at once.

skills.name: Normal Punch
skills.description: An unassuming, basic punch thrown with terrifyingly disproportionate momentum, dealing 250% weapon damage.

skills.name: Quickshot
skills.description: Scout baseline: a fast, low-cost ranged attack (or swift throwing blade) dealing 140% weapon damage.

skills.name: Mark Target
skills.description: Marks the target with Expose for 6s, causing it to take 25% increased damage from all incoming attacks.

skills.name: Evasive Roll
skills.description: Rolls backward to create distance and grants a 2s dodge window with +50% Evasion, synergizing with Counterattack.

skills.name: Trap Snare
skills.description: Deploys a ground snare on the target, dealing 120% weapon damage and Slowing their movement by 50% for 4s.

skills.name: Kill Shot
skills.description: Scout capstone: executes a lethal strike dealing 200% weapon damage, doubled to 400% against targets below 40% health.

skills.name: Rending Cut
skills.description: Dark Knight baseline: a vicious strike infusing dark power into the blade, dealing 150% weapon damage and causing the target to Bleed.

skills.name: Dark Pact
skills.description: Sacrifices 10 HP to unleash a destructive dark surge, dealing 240% weapon damage to the target.

skills.name: Umbral Step
skills.description: Dashes through shadow to instantly close distance to a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 140% weapon damage and Blinding the target for 4s.

skills.name: Soul Drain
skills.description: Strikes the target for 180% weapon damage and siphons their life essence, healing the caster for 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Oblivion Strike
skills.description: Dark Knight capstone: a cataclysmic blow dealing 300% weapon damage, consuming up to 25 bonus energy for +4% extra damage per point consumed.
